statement: Bounded claim: a seal's text predicts only weakly whether its animal is a unicorn. A bag-of-signs logistic model (binary features, C=0.5, balanced class weights) is trained on exploration seals with an identified animal (catch-all codes unknown, None, Othr, Comp, Mult, Misc excluded) and scored on holdout seals with an identified animal whose exact text does not occur in the exploration split. Statistic: balanced accuracy, unicorn vs other. Claim: below 0.60. p = share of bootstrap resamples of the holdout seals whose balanced accuracy is at or above 0.60 (one-sided test of H0: accuracy >= 0.60). Exploration: 5-fold CV 0.49 vs 0.50 chance (results/emblem_scouting.md); dry run on an exploration split 0.38, bootstrap 95% upper 0.46. The bound 0.60 is fixed in advance as 'at most weak'. Support = size of the smaller class (non-unicorn), expected about 30, estimated from exploration counts, not the holdout. If below 15, reported as below planned support. Benjamini-Hochberg across all confirmatory tests.
author: Erin (RN-Top); prepared by Claude
